gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-hind-guntur: Blockletter draws precise, modern capitals with a tall midsection and a pencil line that never leans harder. And Hind Guntur matches that restraint, a plain sans with wide gaps at its curve ends and no thick-thin shift.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-hind-madurai: That tall, squat-bellied midsection with its pencil-flat outline gives Blockletter away at once, while Hind Madurai fills its lines with capital-sized lowercase. Its plain sans curves open wide, so paragraphs move along easily.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-hind-mysuru: Precise and a little stiff in the best way, Blockletter stands tall on its pencil-sketched, squat-bellied letters. Hind Mysuru follows in sans-serif form, lowercase pressing up near ascender height, each a left ajar, no calligraphic thinning.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri lays down a flat gray hum of constant line weight, with rounds that gap like a cracked bangle. Hind Siliguri then runs a long stretch smoothly, approachable and level, beneath Blockletter's tall-bellied headings.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-hind-vadodara: Blockletter's tall, squat-bellied midsection, sketched as if by a pencil that never presses harder, is the first thing you notice. Hind Vadodara sits beside it with unchanging thickness and spacious gaps in its rounds, plain sans and relaxed.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-huninn: Blockletter looks pencil-sketched, with a tall, squat-bellied midsection. Huninn matches it through lowercase rising near cap height and crossbars as fat as their stems, a sans that feels sturdy and modern together.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-inter-tight: Tight, modern and a touch rope-like, Inter Tight keeps short ascenders and curve tails held back, while Blockletter adds a tall, squat-bellied midsection. Over a longer passage the sans-serif body moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-karla: Blockletter keeps every outline free of calligraphic swelling, its tall, squat-bellied letters looking sketched by a pencil that never presses harder. Karla, a plain sans, gapes at the c and stands stocky.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-kedebideri: Pencil-sketched and tall in the belly, Blockletter reads like following a single thread. Kedebideri, a sans-serif, adds a skyward x-height and rounded letters that stay open, so a slightly larger body size would suit it.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-khula: Khula reads with curves that hold their mouths open and a tall midsection, much like the heading. Khula, a plain sans, carries a longer passage steadily, without any thick-thin pulse from Blockletter to lead the eye.
